subject: Commercial proposal for HelioHealth private deployment - node credits & on-call retainer
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@heliohealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 09:12:05 -0700
Subject: Private deployment pricing and credits - RFP follow-up

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for taking the initial call last week. We finished our internal RFP review and want to get a concrete commercial framework for a VPC/on-prem private deployment. High level asks from procurement and infra: 

- Estimate for per-node perpetual or annual license (we expect ~8 nodes initially, scaling to 24).
- Platform fee options: annual amortization vs upfront; can credits be applied against the fee?
- Support tiers and an on-call engineering retainer (we'll likely want 2-month overlap for the pilot).
- Any migration / staging credits you can apply given this is a multi-site rollout (US east + a small EU footprint).

I've attached our RFP summary (Helio_RFP_summary.pdf). Procurement copied here: procurement@heliohealth.com.

Would appreciate a short proposal we can take to legal. Timing is tight — we'd like a commercial outline by next Wednesday (Jun 24).

Best,
Elena
Director of Platform Engineering
HelioHealth

---
Attachment: Helio_RFP_summary.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@heliohealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, olga_petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 11:03:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing and credits - RFP follow-up

Elena —

Thanks for the clear RFP. Quick read-through attached a starter SOW and an initial commercial sketch (RDW_SOW_draft.docx). High-level proposal for discussion: 

1) Node licensing (annual, per-node): $16,000 / node / year (volume tiers for >20 nodes).
2) Platform fee: standard $150,000 / year. Options: amortize monthly over 12/24/36 months or collect upfront with higher crediting against the first-year usage.
3) Migration & staging credits: propose a one-time staging credit equal to 20% of first-year platform fee applied across the first 6 months of usage for pilot-phase risk-share.
4) Engineering retainer (on-call): 0.1 FTE (approx 1 day/week) at $40,000 / year; for higher coverage we can scale to 0.25 FTE or a 24/7 retainer at a higher rate.
5) Support tiers: Standard (business hours, 8x5) / Enhanced (24x7 on-call escalation) with response SLA templates included in the SOW.

Marissa — can you run the concession schedule and show an alternative that moves more credit into-year if Helio is willing to commit 24–36 months?
Olga — can you confirm the on-call resourcing assumptions and whether we can guarantee a 0.1 FTE retainer for the pilot window?

If Helio wants to exchange platform fee reduction for a longer commit, we can draft two alternatives for procurement.

I set a target to have an internal pricing sketch by EOD Monday so we can deliver something firm to you by Jun 24.

Best,
Mateo
Director, Commercial
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: RDW_SOW_draft.docx (Word, 60KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: mateo@redwood.com, Elena Morales <elena@heliohealth.com>
Cc: olga_petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing and credits - RFP follow-up

Thanks Mateo — ran numbers this morning. Two concession patterns that preserve unit economics but unlock Helio's ask: 

Option A (36-month commit):
- Platform fee discounted to $110k / year with a 36-month minimum.
- Staging credit: 25% of year-one platform fee applied as monthly credits across first 6 months.
- Node license: $15,000 / node / year for first 24 nodes; after 24 nodes revert to $16k list.
- On-call retainer: $40k / year (0.1 FTE) with an option to convert to time-and-materials if escalations exceed pre-set thresholds.

Option B (24-month commit + larger upfront payment):
- Platform fee $125k / year with $50k upfront prepay applied as an implementation credit.
- Staging credit: 15% of year-one platform fee.
- Node license stays at $16k list with a small step-down to $15.5k for >30 nodes.

I've attached the model (pricing_model_v1.xlsx) — the sheet shows example cashflow and how credits amortize against license invoices.

Risks / considerations: Helio's ask for EU presence will add minimal egress/regional infra but may change support SLAs; we should be explicit in SOW about region-specific response windows.

Happy to walk through the model in a 30-min call — Mateo, want me to book time with Elena this week?

Marissa
Head of Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: pricing_model_v1.xlsx (Excel, 48KB)

From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, mateo_alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 08:35:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing and credits - engineering note

Quick engineering note for the SOW and retainer sizing: 

- 0.1 FTE retainer is feasible for pilot (continual on-call coverage via rotation + escalation playbook). We'll allocate a named TPM and one escalation engineer.
- For production rollout to multi-site, we recommend a 0.25 FTE retainer or a 24x7 rota for the first 3 months post-cutover.
- Migration credit mechanics: we prefer credits applied as invoice credits against platform fee rather than line-item rebates — keeps bookkeeping simple.
- Security/compliance ask (SOC2 evidence, penetration test summary) — we can provide redacted artifacts and an exec summary; legal will own the redaction.

I'll attach a short ops note for inclusion in the SOW. If Helio wants a deeper on-prem engineering commitment (e.g., embedded onsite SME for a month), we should price that as a separate implementation line.

Olga
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morales <elena@heliohealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@heliohealth.com, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, olga_petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing and credits - RFP follow-up

Mateo / team — thanks for the fast turnaround and the two options. A few immediate notes from procurement and platform leadership: 

- Procurement is okay exploring Option A (36 months) but they'd like the effective platform fee reduction to be front-loaded (we need bigger credits in the first 12 months to offset our implementation runway).
- We are prepared to sign a 36-month commit if you can move to $100k / year platform fee effective year-one (with the staging credits preserved).
- We need clear wording on migration credits being applied as invoice credits (per Olga's note) and an explicit exclusion list for what migration activities are in-scope.
- SOC2 / compliance evidence: please share the redacted pack and pen-test exec summary before legal engages on the final SOW.

If you can send a marked-up term sheet and a DocuSign link for a preliminary commercial letter (non-binding) we can get procurement to sign off and route to our VP of Engineering.

Thanks — can we aim to close the financial terms by EOD Thurs so our legal team has time to review next week?

Elena
Director of Platform Engineering
HelioHealth

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@heliohealth.com>

Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing and credits - RFP follow-up

Elena —

Appreciate the clarity. Summary of agreed commercial path (for internal tracking and to lock into the term sheet): 

- Platform fee: $110,000 / year with a 36-month commit. We will apply a staging credit equal to 25% of year-one platform fee distributed as monthly credits across the first 6 months. If Helio can prepay 50% of year-one platform fee at signing, we will apply an additional $10k implementation credit.
- Node license: $16,000 / node / year, stepping down to $15,000 for the first 24 nodes (as Marissa modeled).
- Engineering retainer: $40,000 / year (0.1 FTE) during pilot, with an option to increase to 0.25 FTE for production rollout. Onsite SME engagement to be priced as a separate line-item.
- Migration credits: applied as invoice credits against platform fee; SOW will clearly list in-scope migration activities (data migration, prefix caching enablement, cutover support) and exclude hardware procurement and third-party networking costs.
- Compliance artifacts: Olga will share a redacted SOC2 pack and pen-test executive summary by EOD tomorrow.

Next steps:
1) Marissa will produce a marked term sheet reflecting the items above.
2) I'll prepare a non-binding commercial letter and send a DocuSign link so procurement can sign and we can lock the pricing.
3) Olga to attach compliance docs for legal review.

Elena — if the $110k / year path looks good, we'll send the DocuSign and term sheet within 24 hours. Appreciate you moving quickly.

Best,
Mateo
Director, Commercial
Redwood Inference
